sloka: अकुतूहलभावेन प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव पार्थिव ।धनदस्यानुजं यो मां नावगच्छसि रावणम् ।। ७.१८.९ ॥
transliteration: akutūhalabhāvena prīto 'smi tava pārthiva ।dhanadasyānujaṁ yo māṁ nāvagacchasi rāvaṇam ।। 7.18.9 ॥

translations.english: Ravana said, "O king, I am pleased by your lack of curiosity, as you do not recognize me, Ravana, the younger brother of Kubera."
